title: Conditions of Premium Under a Pass and Trip Protection Plan
content:
These are the conditions on which the collective charges and collects the premium for a plan written
under Pass and Trip Protection.

**The premium is worked out on the plan's basis.** A flat plan charges its stated premium whatever the covered
value. The result is rounded to the cent and frozen on the plan record.

**Rating on the value covered (no longer in force).** The clause "A plan priced on the value covered charges
its rate of the covered value, then is brought up to the plan's smallest premium where it falls below and
down to its largest where it rises above; the bounds are applied after the rate, never before." is no longer
in force, and a premium on a plan rated on the value covered is not worked out on it. The rate, the smallest
premium and the largest premium the plan carries remain the plan's own figures and remain valid.

**When a premium may be raised.** A premium is raised only while the plan record stands as a quote, in force,
with a claim open, or with a claim settled. That the plan stands in one of those four is answered from the
collective's own plan record for that plan before the premium is raised. A plan standing stopped for
non-payment, given up, expired or closed off is not one on which a premium is raised.

**How the premium is collected.** A plan collected in a single payment takes the whole premium when the plan
is taken.

**Collection alongside the covered holding (no longer in force).** The clause "a plan collected alongside the
covered holding's instalments divides the premium over the instalments still to fall on that holding and is
presented with them." is no longer in force, and the premium presented on such a plan is not worked out on it.

**What non-payment does.** An instalment of premium that goes unpaid past the plan's grace period stops cover.
Premium already paid is not returned when cover stops.

**Condition table.**

| The plan stands | A premium may be raised on it |
| --- | --- |
| As a quote | Yes |
| In force | Yes |
| With a claim open | Yes |
| With a claim settled | Yes |
| Stopped for non-payment | No |
| Given up, expired or closed off | No |
